meta.title: Log in
meta.description: Log in to Clipealo or sign up for free to turn your long videos into clips.

brand.headline: Your best moments, ready to publish.

moments.title: The moments people watch to the end
moments.text: Upload the full video: AI finds the best cuts and tells you why.

ready.title: Ready to publish
ready.text: Captions, 9:16 reframe with tracking, and the right format for each of the six platforms.

earn.title: Get paid for your clips
earn.text: Join campaigns from brands and artists and get paid to your wallet for every 1,000 views.

testimonial.quote: “I upload the full episode on Monday and by Tuesday I have ten captioned clips. It used to take me a whole weekend.”

entrar.title: Welcome back
entrar.text: Log in to pick up your clips, campaigns and wallet.

registro.title: Create your account
registro.text: Free Trial plan: 60 minutes of video a month, no card needed.

recuperar.title: Reset your password
recuperar.text: We’ll send you a link to choose a new one.
